market.what: hydrogen made today (mostly grey, from gas/coal) that stimulated rock H2 would replace, world; stimulated H2 sales today ~0
market.method: IEA: ~100 Mt H2 x ~$1.5/kg (grey $0.8-4.6/kg; China coal ~$1.5/kg) = ~$150B
market.job_what: stimulation chemicals/additives bought for stimulated geologic H2 pilots, world (no commercial wells yet)
market.job_method: est.: ~$10-15M/yr pilot spend (ARPA-E $20M program over ~2-3 yr + Vema $13M seed, Eden etc.) x ~10-20% chemicals share = ~$2M/yr; low confidence

value.logic: if stimulated H2 reaches ~1 Mt/yr (est., ~2035) at <$1/kg vs grey ~$1.5-2/kg + ~10 kg CO2/kg x $50/t: ~$1/kg x 1 Mt = $1B/yr; additive that frees Fe(II) sets rate and yield
value.revenue_logic: year 7 ~0.1 Mt/yr stimulated H2 (est.) x additive budget ~$0.10/kg H2 = $10M; K14 ~30% via supply/license to developers
value.margin_logic: bulk injected chemical must cost <$0.1/kg H2, so priced near commodity unless recycled or catalytic

trend.drivers: H2 demand ~100 Mt growing slowly; clean H2 needs <$1/kg; ARPA-E $20M stimulated-H2 program (16 projects); Japan offtakers; first pilot wells 2026
trend.deadline: US 45V credit only for projects starting construction before 1 Jan 2028

competition.notes: Vema (water + catalyst into ultramafic rock) closest: $13M seed Feb 2025, 2 pilot wells Quebec Feb 2026, <$1/kg claim, commercial 2028; Koloma $400M+ (natural H2); Snowfox $30M A; Mantle8 ~$34M A May 2026

lab.synth: catalog first (chelators, pH/redox modifiers), then 1-2 step custom ligands; 3 variants
lab.test: hydrothermal batch reactors (Parr) with olivine/serpentinite powder + brine + additive at 80-200 C for 4-8 wk; H2 by headspace GC; Fe(II)/Fe(III) by Mossbauer or XRD/titration; university geochem lab
lab.logic: catalog 1 wk + custom 5 wk (overlaps) + reactor runs 8 wk + analysis 2 wk; reagents ~$1k + 2 x $6k CRO + reactor/GC time ~$15k + mineral analysis ~$7k

sale.gates: core-flood tests at reservoir P/T 6-12 mo; field pilot with a developer 1-2 yr; UIC injection permit (Class V/II) for additive; groundwater toxicity review
